hypothesis: Diffusion Model gradually reweights latent space priors during training to preserve existing task knowledge while introducing controlled noise for novel creative output in text generation
description: This approach uses a diffusion process to iteratively refine predictions, balancing fidelity to learned patterns with stochastic exploration at each step; by modulating the influence of prior distributions, it aims to retain mastered structures without rigidly freezing them, potentially allowing the model to generate original content without relearning from scratch
raw:
Hypothesis: Diffusion Model gradually reweights latent space priors during training to preserve existing task knowledge while introducing controlled noise for novel creative output in text generation  

Description: This approach uses a diffusion process to iteratively refine predictions, balancing fidelity to learned patterns with stochastic exploration at each step; by modulating the influence of prior distributions, it aims to retain mastered structures without rigidly freezing them, potentially allowing the model to generate original content without relearning from scratch
